access_evidence: GET api.uktradeinfo.com/ returned HTTP 200 with the OData entity list; $metadata 200 (15,406 B); OTS $apply aggregation 200; 11 requests produced 100 annual UK series rows.
blockers: NO_WORLD_TOTAL_ROW: OTS is CN8 x country x port x flow x month; a UK annual total is a sum computed by the caller and inherits any suppression in the cells.
EU_NON_EU_FLOW_SPLIT: FlowType 1/2 are EU flows and 3/4 non-EU, so reading flow 1 as 'imports' understates UK imports. Imports = 1+3, exports = 2+4.
BREXIT_DISCONTINUITY: the EU/non-EU split is not stable across the 2015-2025 window.
NO_PUBLICATION_DATE: OTS exposes no release timestamp per cell.
historical_depth: OTS monthly from 2000 (Date entity starts at 200001)
licence_note: 'All content is available under the Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated' (uktradeinfo.com site footer, stored at DATASETS/industry/uk_hmrc_trade/raw/portal_home.html).
name: HM Revenue & Customs — UK Trade Info (Overseas Trade Statistics, OData)
rate_policy: No key, no documented quota; collection throttled to ~1.5 req/s.
robots_summary: not relied upon; OGL v3.0 explicitly permits reuse
unlock_route: No blocker: fully open under OGL v3.0.
what_is_new: 100 UK annual aggregates in GBP for 9018/9019/9020/9021/9022 x imports/exports x 2015-2024, computed server-side from the CN8 microcube, plus the exact CN8 child list used for each HS4.
